projects.title: Reproducible Scientific Table Processing
bullets: Reproduced summary tables from raw public scientific inputs as part of a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Assembled a scripted data-cleaning workflow using Python and pandas for reproducible processing of public scientific tables.

projects.title: Course Project on Query Performance
bullets: Compared indexed and unindexed queries on public tabular data within a supervised graduate course project.
Documented query plans for the course project's examination of query performance using SQL and SQLite.
